'''Spicy warra nuts''' or '''Spiced warra nuts''' were another variety of the [[warra nut]]. It was a favorite snack of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]].<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
